At IIT Gandhinagar, research is embedded in everyday learning and crosses disciplinary boundaries to address complex questions. By working at such intersections, students and faculty allow for new perspectives to shape research methods, outputs, and outcomes.
IIT Gandhinagar PhD Scholar develops Innovative hydrogel technology

In a significant boost to India’s biomedical innovation landscape, a research team at the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar has developed an advanced injectable hydrogel technology with promising clinical applications. The smart biomaterial supports minimally invasive procedures, particularly in treating gastrointestinal conditions such as colorectal polyps, by improving precision and reducing procedural risks.

Alumni relations organised an event titled "SETU – Shaping Every Tomorrow United" on April 15, 2026, to introduce graduating students to its alumni ecosystem and lifelong engagement opportunities. Designed as a bridge between student life and alumni connection, the event highlighted ways to stay engaged beyond convocation. Students were introduced to key offerings, including alumni ID cards, membership, Gmail access, and a dedicated alumni portal.

By supporting over 90 startups, hosting 40+ companies, and advancing 100+ patent filings, the Innovation and Entrepreneurship Center and Research Park at IITGN actively advance industry collaboration and technology commercialisation.
